scope: Engineering validation only; excluded from predictor fitting, evaluation labels and evaluation costs
log_retention_issue: The wrapper assumed ray/session_latest/logs. The installed Ray library appends ray to RAY_TMPDIR=/r/ray, giving /r/ray/ray; session_latest may additionally be an absolute link in the container namespace.
repair: Copy regular worker stdout/stderr from real session directories without following links, preserving their relative hierarchy. Require the follow-up diagnostic's exact metric line in the retained log of its identified TaskRunner PID.
